Stage 5 · Java foundations

Composition: Lego, Not Glue

HAS-a beats IS-a for reuse. Snap parts; delegate inward.

⏱ 12 min🧠 No experience needed🧪 Interactive
Step 1

Snap, don’t glue

Swap the gate, keep the castle.

🧱

Lego castle. Walls, gate, tower SNAPPED — each replaceable. Inheritance GLUES: one crack spreads. But true kinds (Student IS Person) still inherit — the TEST decides, not fashion.

Car sketch
class Engine {
  void start() { System.out.println("Vroom"); }
}
class Car {
  private Engine engine = new Engine(); // HAS-a
  void start() { engine.start(); }       // delegate inward
}
Car c = new Car();
c.start(); // "Vroom" — the part did the work
Field + delegate: Car OWNS Engine; start() forwards one line. Swap engines freely; Car’s face never changes.
